mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the belt was most worthwhile: it visibly joined the motor to the projector wheel and clarified the drive arrangement.

leastWorthwhile.text: Flipping the carrier down and back was straightforward but less engaging, although it made fitting the supply underneath clear.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the motor and belt followed the stated goals.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless. The separate motor supply made sense for the added drive.

continue.text: I would be mildly curious to continue and see the assembled carrier operate, but this chapter's mostly prescribed fittings were not a strong hook on their own.
